rationale: Stage 1 v2 reassessment for scope GEO-AGENCY-01 (independent SEO agencies with 2–20 staff serving SMB clients on recurring retainers) under Policy v2 yields INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE to authorize Stage 2 customer discovery (stage2_authorized: false). Although Policy v2 relaxed numeric thresholds (G1 threshold 20 to 5; G3 threshold 5 to 3; G4 threshold 10 to 3), rigorous source review and strict headcount scope enforcement disqualify the candidate signals. Specifically, only G5 PASSES (independent count: 2, supported by verified Clutch directory channel and Butter Marketing with verified 2–9 employees). All 6 audited Reddit pain signals (Typical-Badger1922, nothabkuuys, jjnasty, erickrealz, ThirdEyesOfTheWorld, Arash-60) and 3 agency profiles (What IF Web, SORN.AI profile, SORN.AI cadence) lack explicit source-level verification of team headcount (2–20 staff), placing them in UNKNOWN scope and eligible_gates: []. Furthermore, money signal forensic review eliminated all candidate Gate 3 spend: Arash-60 tool use was normalized from saas_spend to null (no proof of payment); Topify manual hours was reclassified to PARTIALLY_VERIFIED vendor arithmetic; SORN.AI workaround labor was reclassified to PARTIALLY_VERIFIED counterfactual speculation; maltelandwehr Peec AI usage lacked proof of paid spend; and Upwork contract was blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile (PENDING). As a result, in-scope verified counts for G1 (0), G2 (0), G3 (0), and G4 (0) remain at zero against thresholds. Finally, G6 remains UNKNOWN with 7 verified substitute and risk context signals documenting heavy incumbent bundling (SE Ranking €109–€235/mo + €59/mo white-label; Semrush $199–$299/mo), critical sampling variance requiring n=7 repeated queries per prompt, API search supplier costs ($14–$35 per client audit), and OpenAI ToS scraping prohibitions. Because admission criteria for PASS and CONDITIONAL PASS (which requires G1 and G5 PASS with zero FAIL gates) are unmet, customer discovery cannot proceed without targeted research repair.

scope_integrity_notes: All counted evidence strictly adheres to candidate scope GEO-AGENCY-01 as audited in scope-map.json. Bounded audit reviewed 24 high-impact records from the sealed snapshot snap-geo-v2-003. Only two records (Butter Marketing and Clutch Directory Channel) met full in-scope criteria with verified agency headcount (2-20 staff). All Reddit pain records, practitioner accounts, and studio profiles lacking explicit headcount proof were strictly classified as UNKNOWN scope and excluded from G1-G5 counts, preventing artificial inflation. Stated WTP was excluded from numeric counts under Policy v2, and candidate money signals were forensically reviewed to separate free tool use and counterfactual assertions from actual verified spend.

strongest_positive_evidence.finding: Butter Marketing verified on Clutch as a 2-9 employee London agency allocating 70% of its business to GEO for SMB clients.
Clutch directory provides a verified, scalable acquisition channel with explicit 2-9 and 10-49 employee filters and direct contact links.
Detailed operational observation of agency prompt tracking (20 prompts/client weekly) and Looker Studio report compilation (unverified headcount).
Direct practitioner report of intense client expectation management friction across Google AIO, ChatGPT, and Claude (unverified headcount).

strongest_negative_evidence.finding: SE Ranking bundles 100-250 daily AI search prompts across 10-30 client projects for €109-€235/mo with an Agency Pack add-on (€59/mo) providing white-label reports and Looker Studio.
Semrush bundles AI search prompt tracking (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Gemini) directly into Semrush One plans ($199-$549/mo) with branded client exports.
Academic and empirical research (arXiv:2604.07585) shows single prompt checks carry ±0.37 standard error, requiring n=7 repeated queries per prompt to achieve statistical validity.

Official search-grounded API calls cost $10-$25/1k calls (OpenAI), creating direct supplier costs of $14-$35 per client audit under required n=7 sampling and destroying unit economics at $100/mo ARPU.
OpenAI Terms of Use (updated 2026-01-16) explicitly prohibit programmatic data extraction and safety circumvention, invalidating scraping-based architectures.
Agency strategist warns that recurring AI optimization retainers are a 'losing game' due to unreliable tracking, recommending low-lift quarterly audits instead.
Agency owner labels standalone GEO monitoring fees as 'snake oil' and bundles AI checks directly into existing SEO retainers.

top_unknowns: Headcount verification for target agencies: whether the acute operational pain documented on Reddit applies to independent agencies with 2-20 staff or is concentrated in solo consultants and ad-hoc practitioners.

Willingness to pay separate software fees: whether small agencies will pay $100/mo for standalone GEO monitoring when core suites (SE Ranking, Semrush) bundle AI tracking and clients pay $399-$699/mo retainers.

Economic viability under required statistical sampling: whether an accurate multi-client monitoring service can maintain gross margins when n=7 repeated queries are required per prompt at $10-$25/1k API search calls.
Compliance of data pipeline: whether a reliable multi-engine monitoring service can be operated without violating OpenAI and Google terms prohibiting automated consumer UI extraction.
